rationale: Both Kshitij and Mohit work on critical infrastructure at NVIDIA but in complementary domains—Kshitij brings deep expertise in chip-level design verification (AXI, I3C protocols, SystemVerilog/UVM), while Mohit architects the ML systems that run on top of that hardware. Their combined perspective on infrastructure—from silicon verification to ML systems—could surface useful technical conversations about hardware-software co-design or verification challenges in ML accelerators.
intro_message: Kshitij, meet Mohit—you're both building infrastructure at NVIDIA from different angles (chip verification vs. ML systems), and your work likely intersects more than you realize.
